'''''Aechmea pectinata''''' is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] in the [[Bromeliaceae]] (bromeliad) family.<ref>{{cite web
 |url= https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:271740-2
 |title= Aechmea pectinata Baker
 |author=<!--Not stated-->
 |date=n.d.
 |website=Plants of the World Online
 |publisher=The Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew
 |access-date=July 18, 2020}}</ref> This primarily [[Epiphyte|epiphytic]] species is [[Endemism|endemic]] to the [[Southeast Region, Brazil|Southeast Region]] of [[Brazil]], from [[Rio de Janeiro State]] south to [[Paraná (state)|Paraná]] and [[Santa Catarina (state)|Santa Catarina]].<ref name=r>[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=218165 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Martinelli |first1=Gustavo |last2=Vieira |first2=Cláudia Magalhães |last3=Gonzalez |first3=Marcos |last4=Leitman |first4=Paula |last5=Piratininga |first5=Andréa |last6=Costa |first6=Andrea Ferreira da |last7=Forzza |first7=Rafaela Campostrini |title=Bromeliaceae da Mata Atlântica Brasileira: lista de espécies, distribuição e conservação |journal=Rodriguésia |date=January 2008 |volume=59 |issue=1 |pages=209–258 |jstor=23499386 |doi=10.1590/2175-7860200859114 |trans-title=Bromeliaceae of the brazilian Atlantic Forest: checklist, distribution and conservation |language=pt-BR|doi-access=free }}</ref> It is known from the regions in and around [[Petrópolis]] (slightly north of Rio) and south, mainly along the coast, through [[Bertioga]], [[São Paulo]] and [[Curitiba]], including [[Carlos Botelho State Park]], [[Serra dos Órgãos National Park]] and [[Tinguá Biological Reserve]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Observations • iNaturalist |url=https://www.inaturalist.org/observations?place_id=any&subview=map&taxon_id=631046 }}</ref> ''A. pectinata'' is also known as growing within [[Lagamar de Cananéia State Park]], [[Cairuçu Environmental Protection Area]], [[Cachoeiro de Itapemirim]], and [[Superagüi National Park]].<ref name=":0" />
